purpose: Independent source-backed development cases from recent documentaries. Documentary pages establish the title and release; official court, police, transportation-safety, and government records establish each event anchor and hard outcome.

benchmark_policy.selection_use: May be used for house-system model selection, but not as a holdout or as evidence of real-world forensic validity.
benchmark_policy.contamination_note: The fixture was added for the August 2026 development replay and is immediately considered development data. Any reported score on it is in-sample after the first replay.
benchmark_policy.anchor_rule: Never invent a death time. Use an official incident interval midpoint, occurrence time, response marker, or exact transport impact time and label the proxy explicitly.

target_definition.axis_target: Documented event family and scene context, not the documentary's narrative framing.
target_definition.survivability_target: The stated direct-victim or occupant group. Cases without a defensible denominator are left unscored for survivability.
target_definition.scope_note: Aggregate event-chart replay cannot establish an individual's survival probability and is used only as a symbolic engine regression test.
